caseName: Greenberg v. H & H Music Co.
caseNameFull: Greenberg, Independent of Estate of McGann v. H & H Music Co.

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motions of American Public Health Association et al., Bay Area Lawyers for Individual Freedom et al., and Michigan Protection & Advocacy for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief in this case expressing the views of the United States.
